steps.sub: a checkout PR never rebuilds product-catalog

code:
jobs:
  build-test-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npm ci && npm run lint && npm test

      - name: Build image
        run: docker build -t $ACR/product-catalog:${{ github.sha }} .

      - name: Scan image with Trivy
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0
        with:
          severity: CRITICAL
          exit-code: "1"

      - name: Scan for leaked secrets
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2

      - run: docker push $ACR/product-catalog:${{ github.sha }}
caption: Lint/test → build → Trivy → gitleaks → push — any stage failing stops the pipeline

eyebrow: Four gates before an image is trusted
